theBrowserDidnTAllow: The browser didn’t allow copying to the clipboard
expandingWithAiAddsTo: Expanding with AI adds to the board, so it needs edit access.
selectTwoOrMoreSticky: Select two or more sticky notes
goToTheParentA: Go to the parent, a child or a sibling topic
moveATopicUpOr: Move a topic up or down among its siblings
deleteATopicAndIts: Delete a topic and its branch
theAiRequestFailedTry: The AI request failed. Try again.
thatTopicIsGoneOr: That topic is gone or locked.
addedLengthUnderValueUndo: Added {length} under “{value}”. Undo takes them back.
nothingIsOnTheBoard: Nothing is on the board yet. Add puts the ticked ones under the topic, as one step you can undo. AI can be wrong: check them first.
eGForASmall: e.g. for a small team on a budget
theTopicThePathTo: The topic, the path to it and what is under it already are sent to {provider}, set up by
madeAMindMapOf: Made a mind map of {length} notes. Undo puts the notes back.
theseNotesCanTBecome: These notes can’t become a mind map right now.
theNoteYouPickBecomes: The note you pick becomes the central topic; the others become its ideas. One undo puts the notes back.
